Én er giver og holder mobilen. De andre: One player is the dealer and holds the phone. The others guess the value of the next card in the deck – ace is 1, king is 13. Small sips only, and alcohol-free counts just as much.
Den som gjetter, sier en verdi, og giver: The guesser says a value and the dealer taps it. If you miss, the Mystic says ‘higher’ or ‘lower’ and you get one more try.
Riktig på første forsøk: Giveren tar to: Right on the first try: the dealer takes two sips. On the second: one. Miss twice and you take one to three sips – the further off, the more.
Bommer tre etter hverandre, har giveren: When three guessers in a row miss, the dealer has done the job and passes the deck on.
